label: Subject — scrape

label: Description — scrape

label: Specifically — scrape accessible name
summary: Offscreen Select2 focusser for the 'Specifically:' combobox; usable as an anchor for reading accessible state but cannot be clicked or filled directly.
note: OFFSCREEN focusser — pointer events are intercepted by the visible Select2 anchor. Use specificallyChoice to open the drop, select2DropSearch to type, and select2ResultOption to pick. Scrape only via this locator.

label: Specifically — open Select2 dropdown
summary: Visible Select2 anchor (a.select2-choice) for the 'Specifically:' field; clicking it opens the dropdown.
note: Scoped to the Specifically: field's .select2-container ancestor to avoid colliding with the Category Select2. Must click this before using select2DropSearch / select2ResultOption.

label: Category — scrape accessible name
summary: Offscreen Select2 focusser for the 'Category:' combobox; usable as an anchor for reading accessible state but cannot be clicked or filled directly.
note: Same offscreen focusser caveat as specificallyInput. selectOption is tried first on the native <select> before falling back to the Select2 path. Use categoryChoice to open the drop.

label: Category — open Select2 dropdown
summary: Visible Select2 anchor (a.select2-choice) for the 'Category:' field; clicking it opens the dropdown.
note: Scoped to the Category: field's .select2-container ancestor. Must click this before using select2DropSearch / select2ResultOption for Category.

label: Select2 drop search — fill
summary: Search input inside an open Select2 dropdown, scoped per-field via the accessible name 'Select <fieldLabel>:'.
note: Parameterized by fieldLabel (pass 'Specifically' or 'Category'). Scoped by accessible name rather than .select2-drop-active because this ServiceNow build does NOT clear that class when another drop opens, leaving both fields' search inputs in the DOM and causing strict-mode violations.

label: Select2 drop search — scrape
summary: Read the current search text in an open Select2 dropdown for a specific field.
note: Parameterized by fieldLabel; same per-field scoping as the fill variant.

label: Select2 result option — click to select
summary: A result row in the open Select2 dropdown for a specific field, matched by visible label text.
note: Parameterized by fieldLabel and label. Scoped to the field's own .select2-drop via the search input's accessible name, so lingering-active drops from sibling fields do not cause ambiguity. Role inferred from usage (Select2 result item); not a native ARIA role.

label: Attachment file input — upload
summary: Native file input adjacent to the 'Choose a file' button; use setInputFiles rather than clicking the visible button.
note: Clicking the visible 'Choose a file' button triggers an OS file picker; use setInputFiles on this hidden input instead for reliable headless automation.

label: Submit — click
summary: Submit the HR General Inquiry form.
note: Redirects to a ticket detail page; parse the ticket number from the redirect URL (number=HRC0XXXXXX) or scrape the page heading as fallback.
